Tata Trusts Dispute: Noel Tata and Son File Caveats Amid Misgovernance Complaints

Noel Tata, chairman of the Sir Dorabji Tata Trust (SDTT), and his son Neville Tata, a trustee, have filed caveats in the Bombay High Court and the city civil court. This action follows complaints of misgovernance lodged by fellow trustees Venu Srinivasan and Vijay Singh before the Maharashtra Charity Commissioner. The caveats are intended to prevent ex parte orders, and the Charity Commissioner has sought a response regarding the complaints.
